data.notes: January 2027 currently has only a small number of solidly published Lagos nightlife/music listings, with the New Year’s Day Mainland BlockParty as the clearest destination event.

events.title: Mainland BlockParty: Mission 27k
events.summary: Mainland BlockParty’s annual New Year’s Day edition runs from 8:00 PM on January 1 to 5:00 AM on January 2 in Ikeja/Lagos Mainland. The official event page confirms music, DJs, entertainment and ticket tiers, with the exact venue still listed as TBA.

events.title: FESTAC@50
events.summary: A Pan-African and diaspora-focused cultural festival marking 50 years since FESTAC ’77, with concurrent Lagos programming across arts, culture, music, fashion, film and heritage streams into early January.

events.title: Obi’s House Lagos — Monday Nights
events.summary: DJ Obi’s weekly Monday night party at Shiro Lagos is listed as running every Monday through January 4, 2027. The listing describes the night as a high-energy DJ-led Lagos nightlife ritual with curated dancefloor sounds.
